mask_cache_disabled.brief: 判断是否通过环境变量关闭字形掩码缓存 / Test whether the glyph-mask cache was disabled by an environment variable
mask_cache_disabled.details: 读取一次 `HPE_NO_MASK_CACHE` 并缓存结果：变量存在即返回 1。| `HPE_NO_MASK_CACHE` is read once and the result cached; the cache is considered disabled as soon as the variable exists.
mask_cache_disabled.return: 禁用缓存返回 1，否则返回 0 / 1 when the cache is disabled, otherwise 0
mask_cache_disabled.note: 供调试与基准测试绕过掩码缓存 / Debug and benchmark aid for bypassing the run-mask cache

adv_slot.brief: 定位或创建某码点的字宽缓存槽 / Locate or create the advance-cache slot of a code point
adv_slot.details: 以开放寻址线性探测查找码点；`create` 为 0 且缓存未建立时直接返回 `NULL`。| The code point is looked up with linear probing; when `create` is 0 and the table is not yet built it returns `NULL` immediately.

params.cp: Unicode 码点 / Unicode code point
params.create: 表未建立或码点缺失时是否分配空槽 / Whether to allocate a slot when the table is missing or the code point is absent

adv_slot.return: 命中的槽；未命中且允许创建时返回新的空槽，否则返回 `NULL` / The matching entry, a fresh empty entry when creation is allowed, or `NULL`

hpe_font_get.brief: 取（并缓存）指定字号的字体对象 / Get a cached font object for the given size
hpe_font_get.details: 字号四舍五入后夹到 [6, 200]；字重非 700 一律按 400；字体族非 serif/mono 一律按 sans。相同三元组命中同一缓存对象。| The pixel size is rounded and clamped to [6, 200]; any weight other than 700 becomes 400; any family other than serif or mono becomes sans. Identical triples share one cached object.

params.pixel_size: 字号（像素）/ Font size in pixels
params.weight: 字重，仅 700 与 400 两种取值 / Font weight, either 700 or 400 after normalisation

hpe_font_get.return: 缓存的字体对象；平台创建失败时返回 `NULL` / The cached font object, or `NULL` when the platform font could not be created
hpe_font_get.note: 缓存上限 48，超限时整体清空后重建 / The cache holds up to 48 fonts and is flushed wholesale when it overflows; do not free the result

hpe_font_size.brief: 取字体已归整的字号 / Get the font's normalised pixel size

params.font: 字体对象，可为 NULL / Font object, may be NULL

hpe_font_size.return: 字号（像素）；`font` 为 `NULL` 返回 0 / Pixel size, or 0 when `font` is `NULL`

hpe_font_weight.brief: 取字体已归整的字重 / Get the font's normalised weight

params.font: 字体对象，可为 NULL / Font object, may be NULL

hpe_font_weight.return: 字重；`font` 为 `NULL` 返回 400 / The weight, or 400 when `font` is `NULL`

hpe_font_ascent.brief: 取字体的上伸部高度 / Get the font's ascent

params.font: 字体对象，可为 NULL / Font object, may be NULL

hpe_font_ascent.return: 上伸部（像素）；`font` 为 `NULL` 返回 0 / Ascent in pixels, or 0 when `font` is `NULL`

hpe_font_descent.brief: 取字体的下伸部高度 / Get the font's descent

params.font: 字体对象，可为 NULL / Font object, may be NULL

hpe_font_descent.return: 下伸部（像素）；`font` 为 `NULL` 返回 0 / Descent in pixels, or 0 when `font` is `NULL`

hpe_font_line_height.brief: 取字体的默认行高 / Get the font's default line height

params.font: 字体对象，可为 NULL / Font object, may be NULL

hpe_font_line_height.return: 行高（像素）；`font` 为 `NULL` 返回 0 / Line height in pixels, or 0 when `font` is `NULL`

hpe_font_advance.brief: 取单个码点的步进宽度（带缓存）/ Get the advance width of a code point, cached
hpe_font_advance.details: 首次查询某码点时向平台取宽度并写入缓存，之后直接命中缓存。| The width is fetched from the platform on the first query for a code point and stored; later queries hit the cache.

params.codepoint: Unicode 码点 / Unicode code point

hpe_font_advance.return: 步进宽度（像素）；`font` 为 `NULL` 返回 0 / Advance width in pixels, or 0 when `font` is `NULL`
hpe_font_advance.note: 缓存无法分配时退化为每次向平台查询 / Falls back to querying the platform on every call when the cache cannot be allocated

hpe_font_measure.brief: 测量一段 UTF-8 文本的宽度 / Measure the advance width of a UTF-8 text run
hpe_font_measure.details: 逐码点累加步进宽度，换行 `\n` 与回车 `\r` 不占宽度；非法码点处停止累加。| Advance widths are summed code point by code point; `\n` and `\r` contribute nothing and an ill-formed code point stops the scan.

params.len: 文本字节数 / Text length in bytes

hpe_font_measure.return: 文本总宽度（像素）；参数无效或长度为非正数返回 0 / Total width in pixels, or 0 for invalid arguments or a non-positive length

mask_hash.brief: 计算文本字节流的 FNV-1a 哈希 / Compute the FNV-1a hash of a text run

params.len: 文本字节数 / Text length in bytes

mask_hash.return: 64 位哈希值，绝不为 0 / 64-bit hash, never 0

mask_slot.brief: 在掩码缓存中探测空槽或命中槽 / Probe the mask cache for an empty slot or a hit

params.key: 文本哈希键 / Text hash key
params.out_empty: out:首个空槽，未找到时置 `NULL` / First empty slot, or `NULL` when none was found
params.out_hit: out:键命中的槽，未命中时置 `NULL` / Slot matching the key, or `NULL` on a miss

mask_slot.note: 开放寻址线性探测，两者只会有一个非 `NULL` / Open-addressed linear probing, so at most one of the two out parameters is non-`NULL`

mask_flush.brief: 清空字体掩码缓存 / Flush the font's mask cache
mask_flush.note: 释放每个已占用槽的覆盖率掩码并把已用计数归零 / Every occupied slot's coverage mask is freed and the used counter is reset

hpe_font_mask.brief: 取某段 UTF-8 文本的覆盖率掩码（带缓存）/ Get the coverage mask of a UTF-8 run, cached
hpe_font_mask.details: 掩码按「字体 + 文本内容」缓存，稳定帧不再触碰平台光栅化器；缓存负载超过 3/4 时整体清空重建。| Masks are cached per font and text content, so steady-state frames never touch the platform rasterizer; the cache is flushed wholesale once its load factor exceeds 3/4.

params.len: 文本字节数 / Text length in bytes

hpe_font_mask.return: 缓存持有的掩码指针（借出，勿释放）；失败返回 `NULL` / A cache-owned mask pointer that must not be freed, or `NULL` on failure
hpe_font_mask.note: `HPE_NO_MASK_CACHE` 置位时绕过缓存直接走平台光栅化器 / With `HPE_NO_MASK_CACHE` set the platform rasterizer is used directly

hpe_font_shutdown.brief: 销毁全部缓存字体并释放其资源 / Destroy every cached font and release its resources
hpe_font_shutdown.details: 逐个释放掩码缓存、字宽缓存、平台字体与字体对象，并把缓存计数归零。| Each font's mask cache, advance cache, platform font and the object itself are freed, and the cache count is reset to zero.
hpe_font_shutdown.note: 应在引擎退出时调用一次，调用后字体缓存为空 / Call once at engine shutdown; the font cache is empty afterwards
